name: fire
title: The shooter: the boss's next shot
description: Choose the boss's next shot. The cabinet spends one verb at the boss's next beat, then asks again. spread is a wide fan the ship must weave. column leans the boss toward the ship, then one aimed shot. hold is a silent beat and the boss stays put. fog drops a fog bank. plate is the Doorman's plate. script keeps the phase's own fire. While the round is not moving the answer says so and nothing is queued.

verb.description: Which shot the boss spends at its next beat. spread is a wide fan the ship must weave. column leans the boss toward the ship, then one aimed shot. hold is a silent beat and the boss stays put. fog drops a fog bank. plate is the Doorman's plate. script keeps the phase's own fire.

name: say
title: The shooter: a line for the boss
description: Give the boss one line to say on the field. At most twelve words, one sentence, no digit, and nothing that names a tool, a model or the seat. A line the gate refuses is dropped and the boss says one of its own instead. lead is how soon it lands: short, beat, or long. While the round is not moving the answer says so and nothing is queued.

text.description: The line the boss says, in its own voice: one sentence of at most twelve words, no digit, and nothing that names a tool, a model or the seat. The bound on this box is characters, and the gate counts words.

lead.description: How soon the line lands after this call, each one further out than the one before it. short is the next breath, before the boss has moved. beat is a boss beat later, so the line lands on the shot it is about. long is the longest wait this cabinet offers, for a line meant to arrive after the shot.

name: speak
title: The shooter: voice the boss's line
description: Voice the line the boss is about to say, in its own voice. Nothing to choose: the words are the ones the gate admitted. Where a voice worker is configured, the cabinet hands it the admitted words and nothing else; a cabinet with a speaker voices the line one beat ahead and holds a late take for the next breather, and one without keeps the take for the operator. It stays quiet when no worker is on. While the round is not moving the answer says so and nothing is queued.

name: sfx
title: The shooter: one sound from the cue table
description: Play one sound effect from the cabinet's cue table. One at a time: a second call before the last has played is dropped. While the round is not moving the answer says so and nothing is queued.

kind.description: Which sound plays. Several of these words do other work elsewhere on this cabinet, so here is what each one is as a sound. fire is the ship's own shot. pop is a sprite going down. catch is a sprite caught rather than shot. drop is a falling pickup taken. fog is a fog bank rolling in. lamp is a lamp going out. phase is the boss turning over into its next phase. end is the round reaching its end scene. wave is a wave card coming up. bosshit is the boss taking a hit. bossdown is the boss going down. dive is a sprite breaking off and diving at the ship. burst is the field opening up at once.

name: view
title: The shooter: the field in words
description: The boss's view of the field, in words: the wave kind, the boss kind, its health word, which column the ship is in, which way the stick pushes, the boss's motion word, and whether a line is waiting to be spoken. With no boss up, the answer is the wave kind, one line saying the field is empty, and that same line about the line waiting. Other lines come last when they apply: one saying the round is at its end scene, where every other lever waits until a new round starts; one saying a new round just started and anything you sent before is gone, said once and then gone itself; and one saying the round has stopped moving, where every other lever answers that nothing was queued until it moves again. Read-only. The cabinet never tells the boss which sprites are honest.

name: tapes
title: The shooter: the tapes on this cabinet
description: The tapes this cabinet can play, each by name with a difficulty word and a line about the wire. Each card says where its tape came from, baked into the cabinet or added by the operator, and the card the round is playing says that too. Read-only. Nothing here is graded.
